content: SigNoz MCP server (github.com/SigNoz/signoz-mcp-server) exposes 40+ tools across metrics, alerts, dashboards, traces/logs, services/views, notifications, docs. Key tools for Agent K: signoz_search_traces, signoz_aggregate_traces, signoz_get_trace_details, signoz_search_logs, signoz_aggregate_logs, signoz_query_metrics, signoz_list_metrics, signoz_get_alert/signoz_get_alert_history, signoz_list_services/signoz_get_service_top_operations, signoz_execute_builder_query. Self-hosted supports stdio (env vars SIGNOZ_URL/SIGNOZ_API_KEY) or HTTP mode (TRANSPORT_MODE=http, MCP_SERVER_PORT=8000). Requires SigNoz v0.118.0+ for alert history. Docker image signoz/signoz-mcp-server:latest available.
